gen-eater-gf-fresca: Dark and aggressive, Eater sprawls its letters apart with thin strokes that never turn to hairlines. And Fresca stays modern and clean beside it, a plain sans whose line weight runs ruler-straight while the heading swells a little in its curves.
gen-eater-gf-funnel-sans: Menacing up top, professional underneath. Eater's curves run a bit heavier than its joins, while Funnel Sans keeps one fixed-pen stroke and a lowercase e pried wide open, so the loud heading and the quiet text never compete.
gen-eater-gf-gafata: Eater's wide-spaced, hairline-free strokes give it a dark, aggressive snarl. Gafata sits below in a tall band of letters with short stalks, a plain sans whose wide-eyed e keeps a long stretch of text moving smoothly and without strain.
gen-eater-gf-geist: Dark, jagged menace with sturdy bowls and lightly thinned links in the g, all in the heading. Eater is built to snarl, while Geist simply keeps its words as solid, level blocks.
gen-eater-gf-georama: Eater is dark and aggressive, with moderate swelling in its strokes. Its strongest quality here is the gap to Georama, whose bracelet-wide c and barely rising capitals feel approachable where the heading bites.
gen-eater-gf-gidole: Gidole draws every stroke like neon tubing, with open scissor-blade terminals and a high-set midline. And Eater's mild contrast supplies the menace, so the strongest quality is how a wire-thin, tidy sans can sit under something so aggressive.
gen-eater-gf-golos-text: Eater brings dark, aggressive hairlines of reasonable sturdiness. Golos Text meets them with true monoline letters, a tall x-height and a widely parted s, so the sturdy heading and the approachable text stay clearly separate.
gen-eater-gf-hedvig-letters-sans: Gloomy, spiky and unmistakably loud, Eater shows slight but clear stroke modulation at the top. And Hedvig Letters Sans reads approachably, with small letters standing nearly as tall as capitals and a wide gap where each c ends.
gen-eater-gf-heebo: Heebo reads tall and tidy, with curves that stop short instead of closing in. And Eater does the dark, aggressive work, its joins tapering modestly, while the body font simply carries the sentences without fuss.
gen-eater-gf-hind-guntur: Eater looks dark and aggressive, with robust downstrokes against slender turns. And Hind Guntur's strongest quality is its neon-tube thickness, a tall, stamped-metal plain sans that makes the heading's contrast feel even more deliberate.
